Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for an existing low-resolution 2D tiger martial-arts game, effects only.
Create ONE square transparent PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen equal square cells edge-to-edge, no gutters or grid lines. Every cell is one successive animation drawing in left-to-right reading order. Keep the same coordinate center and size basis in every cell. Entire image 1024 by 1024 if possible, each cell representing a 64 by 64 logical pixel sprite enlarged with sharp square pixel clusters.
Subject: a GOLDEN TIGER SPIRIT energy attack facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view. A recognizably rounded tiger muzzle, small rounded ears, broad brow with dark gold stripes, open roaring mouth and short front claws; flowing gold energy behind the head. Proud powerful tiger, never a dragon, fox, wolf, lion or geometric emblem. Effects only, NO human or anthropomorphic character.
Animation layout EXACT:
top row cells 0,1,2,3: golden streaks gather into a small compressed swirl, a tiger brow and muzzle emerge, head half forms, head almost fully forms.
second row cells 4,5,6,7: full tiger spirit head and foreclaws actively roaring, mouth opens and closes slightly, energy mane and loose sparks change shape each frame. Clear readable tiger identity maintained. The forward nose/claw stays no farther than 85 percent of cell width. Energy trails extend left. Design occupies roughly x=12..85%, y=18..80% in each active cell.
third row cells 8,9,10,11: forceful bite/roar impact, tiger silhouette contracts then bursts into broad angular golden ribbons and white-gold light fragments. Change shape rather than fading a copied head.
bottom row cells 12,13,14,15: progressively torn tiger outline and glowing shreds disperse, then sparse small sparks. Last cell has only a few small gold pixels.
Palette: warm ochre, amber, gold, pale cream and near white, 5-7 deliberate solid colors. Brighter core inside golden contours, small dark gold internal facial lines only. Preserve transparent holes between energy ribbons. Crisp intentional limited-color PIXEL ART, readable at actual 64px size, no soft-focus glow or antialias gradients.
Backdrop: genuinely alpha transparent in every cell, including holes. NO floor, colored rectangle, black background, checkerboard pixels, text, numbers, labels, borders, contact sheet separators, watermark. Do not crop across cell boundaries. Align every frame to its equal cell.
